name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2021-05-13.3.2) "*that the Migration Amendment (Clarifying International Obligations for Removal) Bill 2021 be exempted from the cut-off.*" In other words, they voted in favour of ignoring the usual rules - known as [standing orders](https://peo.gov.au/understand-our-parliament/how-parliament-works/parliament-at-work/standing-orders/) - in order to discuss that bill in this sitting period.
